notes: Headless Chrome over CDP with REAL mouse and keyboard input (Input.dispatchMouseEvent / dispatchKeyEvent) against an isolated station served from this worktree. Floor rigs (an INBOX for a fragment, a room with BAYs and hand-laid runs that meet and run on as one belt, a lone BAY) were laid through the validated WorldModel API; every verified gesture was real input. One routine was created through the same POST /api/cron the Workflow panel's CREATE ROUTINE sends (scheduled for 1 January, removed and the scheduler disarmed afterwards).

build-12 and build-13 ran on the lane's station (127.0.0.1:9682, the final-floor-lane launch entry). Mid-pass the shared scratch folder holding that station's workspace and launcher was deleted from outside this lane, so build-10 and build-17 ran on a fresh keyless isolated station booted from this worktree (127.0.0.1:9683, dev seed, no provider key). The build-17 belt-card label and peek checks ran on the final source; build-12 / build-13 code was unchanged after their runs.

SEND TO arcs were counted at the canvas: moveTo + quadraticCurveTo observed for ONE synchronous frame (Build.__test__.frame) and restored - a read of what the frame drew. Screenshots: gen-trees/_final-shots/wave2-floor-repair/ (not committed).
